functions.name: fn_8018ABD4
functions.divergence: Canonical GC/1.3 assigns the fn_8018D020 callback and 24-byte vertex offset live ranges to r27 and r26 opposite retail r26 and r27, producing five operand differences with otherwise identical size and instruction selection.

counter_reconciliation: The headline counters use ordinary build/GEDE01/report.json acceptance. The strict report uses function_reloc_diffs=name_address and therefore rejects additional functions and code bytes whose relocation names or addresses differ. These are distinct accounting modes, not two claims for the same predicate; exact extraction commands and raw outputs are in reports/GEDE01/session-1355-remediation-1-verification.json.
reusable_lesson: Correcting the ABI from four apparent parameters to one object argument, declaring the callback with its recovered six-parameter function type, and removing the no-op comma expression leaves the same r26/r27 callback-versus-byte-offset swap. Dead parameters and discarded comma operands must not be retained as register-allocation bait; this declaration-order variant is a measured dead end.
